resources.string: Prop the device up where it can see your dog, its bed and its bowls. Keep this screen open: the camera only works while the device is unlocked, so Bridgit keeps the screen on. Device only sends nothing to the server. If you enable a personal backend and photo sharing for this applet on this device, its private gallery keeps seven days or the newest 100 images (up to 10 MB).
Watching · a photo every 10 seconds · %1$d checked · %2$d unchanged, not sent
· %1$d missed by the photo comparison (caught by the hourly check)

Clef (Cloudflare) is on by default. You can use Jev (TypeSafe), Clef, or both. With both on, each checks the same photo; totals use Clef when it answers, otherwise Jev. Turn both off to stop watching.
Share photos in My applets gallery

Linked to %1$s. With this applet’s personal backend enabled on this device, My applets shows new observations and metrics. Photo sharing keeps seven days or the newest 100 images (up to 10 MB). Invited viewers can see only this applet. Turning photo sharing off deletes its server images.
Choose Personal backend for this applet on this device and link your account to upload new observations. Device only sends nothing; no earlier photos are uploaded.
No rest periods, meals or drinks seen yet.

Resting means lying or sitting quietly; a photo cannot confirm sleep. Totals estimate time from 10-second checks. Sessions show the span from first to last sighting and can include short gaps. One sighting cannot tell whether an activity lasted less than 10 seconds; activities between checks may be missed.

Add a camera in Devices, then include it here using Device access.

Enable Pet monitor’s personal backend on this device? New observations and metrics will be uploaded. If photo sharing is on, keep seven days or the newest 100 images (up to 10 MB). People you invite with Gmail can view this applet only. Clef/Jev send photos for remote AI analysis. Other devices and applets keep their own choices.
Use device only? Stop uploads and remote AI, revoke viewers and delete this applet’s server history. Local records stay. If offline, deletion is retried and shown as pending.
Keep this app’s data on this device. Remote AI is unavailable.
See new observations, metrics and shared photos on the web. Connect your account to use Clef and Jev for remote AI analysis.

The built-in microphone listens on the phone for loud sounds while monitoring runs (turned on the first time you start). Only a loud sound goes to Clef, to tell whether it is barking: at most 6 checks an hour. A loud sound within 5 minutes that sounds like the last one checked (compared on the phone) reuses that answer, so a long bout of barking costs one check. Camera microphones take a 5-second sample about every 10 minutes (every sampling interval, default 20 seconds, for the food view). Audio clips are not kept.
Listening for loud sounds; barking is checked when one is heard
The built-in microphone can\'t listen right now (Bridgit needs to be on, with microphone and notification permission)
%1$s is listening to the %2$s microphone for loud sounds
Camera microphones: listening for loud sounds; barking is checked when one is heard

Camera microphones: a 5-second sample about every 10 minutes until the camera stream connects
Barking continues (counted without a new check)

Loud sound heard; the hourly check limit is reached, so it wasn\'t checked
Sound checks paused for an hour: the Clef budget is used up
When the Pet monitor hears your dog start barking.
Heard at %1$s. More barking in the next few minutes is counted without another alert.

Seconds without seeing your pet before Auto checks the other cameras. Applies only to this camera in Pet monitor on this device. Default: the all-cameras value. Checks repeat at this interval while your pet is missing. With multiple active views, each must reach its interval. Capture and processing time can delay a check.
Enter a whole number from 10 to 3600 seconds.

How often Pet monitor samples the cameras and microphones it is not using: Auto checks the other cameras after this long without seeing your pet, and the food-view microphone takes a sample this often. Applies to every camera and microphone without its own value. Default: 20 seconds. The camera in use still takes a photo every 10 seconds.
Look around when the pet is missing

Optional: after 1 minute without a sighting, a supported pan/tilt camera checks nearby views around its last confirmed position. Each search lasts at most 1 minute, with at least 5 minutes between searches. Stop monitoring, turn this off, or use the camera’s Stop control to stop a search. Remote analysis uses your selected models.
